scope: Theorem 3.1 (Uniform divisibility for generating tuples) of the manuscript “The Blockwise Alperin Weight Conjecture” (preprints/The-Blockwise-Alperin-Weight-Conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 202 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 042c7730f058d508), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let J be a finite group with Op(J) = 1. For s ≥ 0, n = ps, and a multiset M of n conjugacy classes of p-singular elements of J, let NJ,s(M) be the number, modulo simultaneous J-conjugation, of ordered tuples (x, y, u1, . . . , un) ∈ Jn+2 satisfying [x, y]u1 · · · un = 1, ⟨x, y, u1, . . . , un⟩ = J, {[u1], . . . , [un]} = M. (3.1) For every integer h ≥ 1, there is an integer s0 = s0(p, J, h) such that ph | NJ,s(M) (s ≥ s0) for every such multiset M.
